sources.locator: zeron.every at 220-224; zeron.run at 266-268; service/mod.rs:656-674; apps/zgx/plugins-dev/README.md
sources.finding: A user-installed, allowed plugin service can register zeron.every callbacks (minimum 30 seconds). The engine fires callbacks headlessly and restarts stopped services for due timers. With the commands grant, zeron.run executes permitted programs, so a plugin can periodically launch a configured agent command without a per-run prompt. The engine host must remain running.
